no_cost_alternative.status: reader and bounded lossless compaction implemented; production compaction pending verification
no_cost_alternative.method: Keep every object key and published decoded SHA-256; atomically replace only the compressed representation, verify readback, retain rollback bytes until verification. No raw evidence, receipt or record is deleted. Existing 250 GB budget remains.
no_cost_alternative.postgres_note: Separate database ceiling remains; this archive compaction does not reclaim PostgreSQL disk.
